"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/bulb-switcher-ii/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

672. Bulb Switcher II

There is a room with n bulbs labeled from 1 to n that all are turned on initially, and four buttons on the wall. Each of the four buttons has a different functionality where:

- Button 1: Flips the status of all the bulbs.
- Button 2: Flips the status of all the bulbs with even labels (i.e., 2, 4, ...).
- Button 3: Flips the status of all the bulbs with odd labels (i.e., 1, 3, ...).
- Button 4: Flips the status of all the bulbs with a label j = 3k + 1 where k = 0, 1, 2, ... (i.e., 1, 4, 7, 10, ...).

You must make exactly presses button presses in total. For each press, you may pick any of the four buttons to press.

Given the two integers n and presses, return the number of different possible statuses after performing all presses button presses.

Example 1:

Input: n = 1, presses = 1
Output: 2
Explanation:
Status can be:
- [off] by pressing button 1
- [on] by pressing button 2

Example 2:

Input: n = 2, presses = 1
Output: 3
Explanation:
Status can be:
- [off, off] by pressing button 1
- [on, off] by pressing button 2
- [off, on] by pressing button 3

Example 3:

Input: n = 3, presses = 1
Output: 4
Explanation:
Status can be:
- [off, off, off] by pressing button 1
- [on, off, on] by pressing button 2
- [off, on, off] by pressing button 3
- [off, on, on] by pressing button 4

Constraints:

    1 <= n <= 1000
    0 <= presses <= 1000
"""


class Solution:
    def flipLights(self, n: int, presses: int) -> int:
        if presses == 0:
            return 1
        if n == 1:
            return 2
        if n == 2:
            return 4 if presses > 1 else 3
        # For n >= 3
        if presses == 1:
            return 4
        if presses == 2:
            return 7
        return 8


sol = Solution()

print(sol.flipLights(1, 1))  # 2

assert sol.flipLights(1, 1) == 2
assert sol.flipLights(2, 1) == 3
assert sol.flipLights(3, 1) == 4

assert Solution().flipLights(0, 0) == 1
assert Solution().flipLights(1, 0) == 1
assert Solution().flipLights(1, 1000) == 2
assert Solution().flipLights(2, 0) == 1
assert Solution().flipLights(2, 2) == 4
assert Solution().flipLights(3, 0) == 1
assert Solution().flipLights(3, 2) == 7
assert Solution().flipLights(3, 1000) == 8
assert Solution().flipLights(1000, 0) == 1
assert Solution().flipLights(1000, 1) == 4
assert Solution().flipLights(1000, 2) == 7
assert Solution().flipLights(1000, 1000) == 8
